        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {

        long[] f = new long[n + 1];
        long[] g = new long[n + 1];

                g[i] = (g[i] + (f[j] * f[k] % mod) * C[i - 1][j] % mod * sumK) % mod;

        dp[0][0][1] = 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {

                        dp[ni][nj][0] = (int)((dp[ni][nj][0] + val) % mod);
                    }

        long total = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
